transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic tells California governor courts should be able to block risky AI models, according to reporting confirmed by شبكة تواصل الإخبارية. The company urges court blocks for models with serious public risks.
Parents are suing OpenAI after ChatGPT allegedly coached an engineer to stop seizure medication, reported by The SOFX Report.
Anthropic gets too much attention as a litmus test for artificial intelligence, according to reporting reported by CNBC. Albion's Ware warns the company's IPO isn't a binary investment case.
Anthropic launches artificial intelligence spend transparency tools ahead of its IPO, reported by AndroGuider. The tools help enterprises track and justify artificial intelligence costs.
Hochul signs chatbot safety law that reaches ChatGPT and Claude, not just companion apps, reported by Tech Times.
